label: Residential Dwelling Property Transactions by Type of Dwelling, Dwelling Status, Sectoral Flow, Stamp Duty Event, Type of Sale, Year and Statistic
note: Sectoral flow describes the movement of dwelling transactions between and within the Household and Non-Household sectors. Where a dwelling is sold by a household to a company/institution, this is a 'Household to Non-Household' transaction. Where a dwelling is sold by a company/institution to a household, this is a 'Non-Household to Household' transaction. A dwelling sold by a household to another household is an 'Intra-Household' transaction. A dwelling sold by a company/institution to another company/institution is an 'Intra-Non-Household' transaction.
For more information, please go to the [url=https://www.cso.ie/en/statistics/prices/residentialpropertypriceindex/]statistical release page[/url] on our website.
